record.original_question: Does every 4-edge-connected graph admit a nowhere-zero 3-flow?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 5.7 Every 4-edge-connected graph has a nowhere-zero 3-flow.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G = (V, E) be a finite (multi)graph. An orientation of G assigns a direction to each edge. A nowhere-zero 3-flow on G is a pair (D, f), where D is an orientation of G and f : E → {±1, ±2} is an edge function, such that for every vertex v ∈ V the conservation law

    ∑_{e ∈ δ^+(v)} f(e) − ∑_{e ∈ δ^-(v)} f(e) ≡ 0 (mod 3)

holds, where δ^+(v) and δ^-(v) denote the sets of edges leaving and entering v under D. (Equivalently, G admits a nowhere-zero 3-flow if and only if it has an orientation in which, at every vertex, the in-degree and out-degree are congruent modulo 3.)

A graph G is k-edge-connected if |V(G)| ≥ 2 and G − F is connected for every edge subset F ⊆ E(G) with |F| < k.

Question: Does every 4-edge-connected graph admit a nowhere-zero 3-flow?
artifact.status_search_result: Tutte's 3-flow conjecture (1972) remains open for 4-edge-connected graphs. The strongest general result is by Lovász, Thomassen, Wu and Zhang, who proved the conjecture for 6-edge-connected graphs (improving Thomassen's 8-edge-connected result). Kochol showed it suffices to prove the conjecture for 5-edge-connected graphs. The 4-edge-connected case is still unresolved.

status_evidence.snippet: Tutte's 3-Flow Conjecture: all 4-edge-connected graphs have a nowhere-zero 3-flow. Still open.

status_evidence.title: Nowhere-zero 3-flows and modulo k-orientations
status_evidence.snippet: Lovász, Thomassen, Wu and Zhang proved that every 6-edge-connected graph has a nowhere-zero 3-flow.
status_evidence.claim: Best known partial result is for 6-edge-connected graphs.

status_evidence.title: Lecture notes on Tutte's flow conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: Kochol (2001) reduced the 3-flow conjecture to 5-edge-connected graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Reduction shows it suffices to prove it for 5-edge-connected graphs, but the 4-edge-connected case is still open.
